basic_info.description: Welcome to this stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bath sunlit Marina condominium, nestled in a charming boutique Mediterranean building just steps from the iconic Palace of Fine Arts. With beautiful southern exposure, this remodeled home features a spacious formal living room and dining room, both with recessed lighting throughout. The recently remodeled chef's kitchen is a true masterpiece, boasting custom solid walnut cabinets, a Wolf dual-fuel range, a pot-filler faucet, and a wine fridge. Finishing touches include a striking Tahitian Cream Quartzite backsplash, Caesarstone countertops with a waterfall edge, and a cozy breakfast area that seamlessly blends functionality and style. Two spacious en-suite bedrooms each offer their own remodeled bathrooms and large walk-in closets.    Building amenities include a newly remodeled lobby and hallways, a secure entrance with an video intercom system, and a shared roof deck offering breathtaking views of the Palace of Fine Arts. Residents can also enjoy a small shared yard, seismic upgrades to the building, assigned parking for one car, and a locked storage closet in the garage.    Ideally situated in the heart of the Marina, this exceptional property offers easy access to Crissy Field and the vibrant shopping and dining scene on Chestnut Street
